assertions.name: covariance_epic_M1_antidiagonal_reformulation
assertions.source: M_1 = Cov(sum(i+j), sum c^2) = 2Cov(n_lam,sum c^2) = Cov(sum h, sum h^2) (n<=17); Cov>0, rho in [0.85,0.92] near-perfect; Var(sum c^2)=|C3|; no harmonic-augmented closed form; Kerov-CLT integral is the proof route. Reformulation+route, not a proof. No fit; no c_k.

description: A clean reformulation + concrete proof route for the first odd moment M_1>0 (qou-x631, qou-ogrk), the open base case of odd-moment positivity. Via transpose symmetry M_1 = Cov_Planch(Σ_□ h, Σ_□ h²) = 2 Cov(n_λ,Σc²) = Cov_Planch(Σ_□(i+j), Σ_□(j−i)²) — the antidiagonal spread Σb (b=i+j) vs the diagonal spread Σc² (verified equal, n≤17). Σb is transpose-EVEN yet ∉ the shifted-symmetric algebra A, which is why M_1 is non-polynomial. Supporting facts (exact n≤19): Cov>0 robustly with near-perfect correlation ρ≈0.85–0.92 (non-degenerate, does not decay); Var(Σc²)=|C₃|=n(n−1)(n−2)/3 exactly; and M_1 is NOT a harmonic-augmented polynomial (poly₄ and n²H_n+poly₃ fits both fail — no cheap closed form). Proof route: Kerov CLT — both statistics are quadratic-in-position moments, so Cov(Σb,Σc²)=∬φ(x)ψ(y)K_Δ(x,y) against Kerov's explicit Gaussian-profile covariance kernel, a positive quadratic form ⇒ Cov>0 asymptotically with explicit constant; exact small-n covers the tail. Executing that integral is the open next step. Reformulation + route, NOT a proof of M_1, odd positivity, A2, or the kernel (all open). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 unchanged.

data.reformulation: M_1 = Cov_Planch(sum(i+j), sum c^2)  (antidiagonal vs diagonal spread)
data.proof_route: Kerov CLT: Cov = double integral of phi*psi against Gaussian profile kernel K_Delta (positive quadratic form)
